section.title: Adversarial review
section.description: A critic on another provider reviews every change this agent delivers, and records a verdict.
section.description_squad: A critic on another provider reviews every change this squad delivers, and records a verdict.
section.require_distinct_provider_hint: Without one on another provider, the review is skipped and said so.
section.blocking: Hold the issue until the verdict
section.blocking_hint: The issue waits in review. A member can always move it anyway.
section.max_rounds_hint: How many times a blocked change may come back.
section.budget_hint: Total spent on the issue, in dollars. Past it the loop stops.
section.error_critic_required: Choose a critic before enabling adversarial review.
section.error_critic_is_author: An agent cannot be its own critic.
